Commentary.Commentary: So, 199 to get for Sri Lanka to win the final game of the series. The pitch is a good one to bat on but it will take some effort for the Sri Lankan batsmen to get there. Someone will need to step up to the occasion and guide the team through. As for South Africa, the batsmen have done the job now the onus will be on the bowlers to restrict them under 198. The chase is not far away. Join us in a bit for the second innings.
As for the Sri Lankan bowling. None of the bowlers were left unpunished and everyone except Dhananjaya de Silva went for at least 9 runs per over. Dhananjaya though just bowled one.

In what was a surprise, Dwaine Pretorius walked out at number 3. Him and Reeza Hendricks put on a 90 run stand for the 4th wicket stand. Reeza Hendricks got to his 4th T20I fifty and his second consecutive one. He departed in the 15th over but skipper, JP Duminy joined Pretorius and they took all the bowlers to the cleaners and put on a 71-run stand of just 30 deliveries. Dwaine Pretorius also got to his maiden half-century in the process.
71 runs off the last 5 overs has seen South Africa post a massive total of 198. The innings did not start in the best of fashion. Aiden Markram departed early but then it was all South Africa.
Slower delivery on leg, Pretorius plays it over square leg for a single. SOUTH AFRICA FINISH WITH 198/2 IN 20 OVERS.
Full and outside off, Duminy drives it towards covers for a single.
Short of a length delivery on leg, Pretorius plays a half pull over mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Excellent shot. Full toss on leg, Pretorius flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full and outside off, Duminy squeezes it towards point for a single.
Slower delivery on leg, Pretorius looks to smash it but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It goes towards the leg side. The batsmen take a run.

SIX! 4 off the first 4 ball but the over ends with 16 runs. Second consecutive maximum. This is even better. Full on middle and leg, Duminy moves across just a bit towards his leg stump and whacks it over the long on fence for a six.
SIX! Commentators curse this. Full length delivery on middle, Duminy heaves it over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
50-run stand between the two. It has come off just 24 balls. It is on a length on middle and leg, Dwaine tucks it to mid-wicket for a single. 4 off the first 4 deliveries.
Dot ball. This is worth in gold at this stage. Slower delivery on a length. It is outside off, Pretorius looks to pull it but gets beaten by the lack of pace on it.
Fuller delivery outside off, Duminy looks to slash it to the off side but gets a bottom edge and it goes towards third man for a single.
Wide! Bouncer bounces too high. It is on middle, Duminy looks to pull it but realizes it is way over his head.
Full length delivery, going down the leg side. Pretorius looks to flick it but it goes off his pad towards the on side. Single taken. Leg bye signalled.
Isuru Udana to bowl the penultimate over.
Bowls it down the leg side, Duminy looks to go after it but misses it. Expensive over from Sri Lanka. 17 runs have come from the over.
WIDE! Poor bowling from Lasith Malinga. Bowls it down the leg side, Duminy looks to flick but misses it.
FOUR! 14 runs of the last three balls. Full on off, Duminy lofts it over mid off for a boundary. This is carnage from South Africa.
SIX! This is even better from the skipper. Short of a length delivery on leg, Duminy pulls it over square leg for a maximum.
FOUR! Amazing shot. Full toss on leg, Duminy flicks it through square leg for a boundary.
Bowls a yorker on leg, Duminy looks to dig it out but gets hit on the boot. He was hit very hard.
Full on middle, Duminy drives it towards mid on for a single.
Lasith Malinga is back into the attack.
Single to end the over. On the pads again by Akila. Duminy tucks it to the on side and keeps the strike. Another 10 plus over this. 14 off it. 29 off the last 2.
Lands it short this time outside off, Pretorius punches it towards cover for a single.
SIX! When Pretorius hits it stays hit. Flighted on middle, Dwaine gets on one knee. He gets his front leg out of the way and thrashes it over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
On middle and leg this time, JP nudges it towards mid-wicket for a single.
On middle and leg, Dwaine flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Poor start this from Akila. Bowls a full toss on the pads of Pretorius. It is a freebie for Dwaine, he slashes it through square leg. For a moment it looked like the fielder will gather it but he cannot.
Akila Dananjaya is back into the attack.
Again on a length on off, Pretorius plays it towards point for a run.
Length delivery outside off, Duminy looks to drive but gets an outside edge. It goes towards third man for a single.
DROPPED! Length delivery on off, Pretorius looks to flick but gets a leading edge. It goes towards covers where the fielder drops the catch. It was a tough chance. The batsmen take a run.
FOUR! Third consecutive boundary for him. Short of a length delivery, Pretorius looks to pull but gets a top edge. It goes over third man for a boundary.

FOUR! Fifty for Dwaine Pretorius. Maiden T2OI fifty for him. What an innings this has been from him. Full and outside off, Pretorius looks to drive but gets an outside edge. It goes over point for a boundary. He was promoted ahead of Duminy and that move has paid off.
FOUR! WHAT A SHOT. Full toss outside off, Pretorius smashes it straight past the bowler through mid off for a boundary. It was hit very hard.
Suranga Lakmal is back into the attack.
JP Duminy is the new batsman in.

OUT! Bowled! Huge wicket this for Sri Lanka and a very good comeback from Vandersay. After being hit for a six in the previous ball, Vandersay shows courage and tosses it up on middle and leg. Hendricks looks to sweep it but misses. The ball goes onto hit the middle and leg pole. End of a very good innings from Reeza Hendricks. He was looking hot and dangerous out in the middle but has to walk back.
SIX! Reeza is on fire today. Tossed up on off, Hendricks heaves it over long off fence for a maximum.
Short and straight outside off, Hendricks looks to cut it but misses.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single
Flighted on off and middle, Pretorius gets down on one knee and sweeps it wide of deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Good running! Shorter on off, Pretorious hits it wide of deep cover and gets a brace. Hendricks was a bit hesitant but responds well.
Jeffrey Vandersay back on.
DROPPED! It was a sitter from Dhananjaya. Full toss outside off, Hendricks smashes it towards point where Dhananjaya de Silva drops the catch. 7 runs have come from the over.
Full toss outside off, Pretorius drives it towards mid off for a run.
FOUR! Nice shot. Full and outside off, Pretorius drives it through point for a boundary.
Full on off, Pretorius drives it to mid off.
Length delivery on middle, Hendricks nudges it towards square leg for a single.
Full toss outside off, Pretorius plays it to mid off for a single.
Isuru Udana is back into the attack.
Bowls it flatter on middle and leg, Dwaine tucks it to the on side and keeps the strike. Good over for South Africa. 13 off it.
SIX! This is out of here. Tossed up delivery on middle, Pretorius comes down the track and sends it sailing over long on fence for a maximum.
On the pads now, Reeza tucks it towards square leg and gets a single.
FOUR! Excellent use of the feet this time by Reeza! Flighted on off, Hendricks comes down the track and whacks this through covers for a boundary.
Play and a miss. Shorter outside off, it is too close to be cut. Hendricks attempts to do so but misses.
Shorter off spinner on off, Pretorius pulls it to deep mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Akila Dananjaya brought back.
Flighted delivery on off, Hendricks defends it off the front foot. Big over for South Africa. 14 runs have come from the over.
FOUR! Floated on middle, Hendricks looks to sweep but gets an inside edge. It goes past the stumps towards fine leg for a boundary.
Tossed up outside off, Pretorius hits it over covers. The fielder at deep cover tries to stop it but fumbles. He manages to stop it before the ropes. The batsmen take three runs.
50 for Reeza Hendricks. 4th T20I fifty for him. Outstanding innings from him. Floated on off, Hendricks drives it towards covers for a run.
SIX! THAT IS WHACKED AWAY! Floated on middle, Hendricks gets on one knee and plays a slog sweep over mid-wicket for a maximum.
Short and outside off, Hendricks cuts it to point.
On the pads, Reeza flicks it away towards mid-wicket for a single. Keeps the strike. Expensive over from Malinga, 12 off it. 31 off the last 3.
FOUR! Make that two in two. Full ball this time, Hendricks gets on his front foot and drives this through covers for a boundary.
FOUR! Malinga offers width this time and Hendricks makes full use of it. It is on a length and Reeza slaps it through point for a boundary.
Full on off, Reeza strokes it straight to mid off.
Full length delivery on middle and leg, Hendricks lofts it wide of deep mid-wicket for a couple.

Safe! Sri Lanka lose their review. Off cutter on a length, Pretorius looks to play it across the line. He misses it and the ball flushes his back pad. Malinga asks the question. The umpire turns it down. Malinga has a discussion with his teammates and takes it upstairs. Hawk Eye shows that the impact was umpire's call and it would have missed the leg pole.
Review time. Sri Lanka review for LBW. It looks to be missing the leg stump.
Lasith Malinga is back on.
Single to end the over. 10 runs off the over. Flighted outside off, Pretorius dabs it towards point and keeps the strike.
Flighted outside off, Pretorius lofts it over covers and gets a brace.
SIX! Pretorius takes the aerial route. First tossed up delivery on middle, Pretorius gets on one knee and slog sweeps it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Third short ball of the over this. Pretorious pulls it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Short again on middle, Pretorius taps it back to the bowler.
Starts with a shorter delivery on middle and off,  Hendricks gets on his back foot and strokes it towards cover for a single.
Jeffrey Vandersay is introduced into the attack.
Floated on off, Reeza plays it towards covers for a single. 9 runs have come from the over. Good one for South Africa.
Short on off, Pretorius cuts it towards point for a single.
Short on middle, Pretorius pulls it through mid-wicket. The batsmen pick up a couple.
FOUR! Good shot. Full on middle, Pretorius drives it straight past the bowler through mid on for a boundary.
Tossed up outside off, Pretorius looks to cut but misses it due to the turn on this one.
Floated on middle, Hendricks nudges it towards square leg for a single.

Flighted outside off, Hendricks plays it towards cover. Reeza wanted a run but Pretorius did not. Avishka Fernando misfields there which allows them to get the single. Second misfield from Avishka in the same over.
Follows it up with a dot. Good length delivery on off, Reeza blocks it off his back foot.
FOUR! Hendricks continues his good form. Back of a length delivery on off and middle, Hendricks maintains his balance and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Misfield again. Fuller delivery outside off, Pretorius drives it to mid off. Avishka misfields there allowing them to scamper through for a single.
Good length delivery on middle, Hendricks pulls it away towards square leg for a single.
Good length delivery on off, Hendricks hits it off the middle of the bat but straight to the fielder at point.
Floated on middle, Reeza punches it towards covers for a single.
Full on middle, Pretorius drives it towards mid on for a run.
Short and outside off, Hendricks cuts it towards point for a run.
Full on off, Pretorius drives it towards mid off for a single.
Flighted delivery on middle, Hendricks flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up on off, Pretorius drives it towards mid off for a run.
Akila Dananjaya is into the attack.
On the pads again, Pretorious is off the mark straightaway with a flick down to square leg. 9 runs off the over but more importantly a wicket.
Dwaine Pretorius is the new batsman in.

OUT! Caught! Lakmal has the last laugh. Good length delivery on off, Markram looks to heave it over long on. He does not time it well and it hits high on his bat. It goes high in the air. It does not travel far and falls straight to Lasith Malinga at mid on.
Outside off this time, Hendricks dabs it down to third man and rotates the strike.
Length delivery outside off, Aiden punches it wide of cover and takes a quick single.
SIX! Powerful stroke this from Markram. Back of a length delivery on off, Markram picks the length early and pulls it over the square leg fence for a maximum.
Good length delivery on off, Aiden pushes it to point.
Full on middle and leg, Markram plays it wide of mid on and keeps the strike. 8 off the over.
Udana is bowling on the pads and the South African batsmen are having no problems facing them. It is full, Hendricks flicks it to mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Full on the pads, Markram tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
On middle and leg this time, Hendricks flicks it to the on side for a run.
Dot ball to follow the four. On a length on off stump, Reeza blocks it off his back foot.
FOUR! Poor effort in the field by Dhananjaya de Silva. Good length delivery outside off, Hendricks cuts it hard towards point. De Silva misfields there and the ball races away to the fence.
Isuru Udana is back into the attack.
On a good length on middle, Hendricks tucks it towards the leg side for a run.
FOUR! Nice shot. Second boundary for Reeza Hendricks. Length delivery on middle, Hendricks flicks it through square leg for a boundary.
On a good length on off, Hendricks looks to defend but gets hit on the glove.
Length delivery on middle, Markram flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
On a good length on middle, Hendricks plays it towards point for a run.
On a good length on middle, Hendricks defends it off the back foot.
Suranga Lakmal is into the attack.
On the pads this time, Reeza flicks it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Flighted on middle, Hendricks blocks it.
Short again this time closer to the stumps, Hendricks punches it to the fielder at cover.
FOUR! Short, wide and punished by Hendricks. De Silva lands it outside off, Hendricks' eyes lit up looking at the width on offer and slaps it through point for a boundary.
This time Hendricks blocks it perfectly. De Silva lands it short on off, Reeza blocks it off his back foot.
Straightaway finds the edge of Reeza's bat. Flighted on middle and leg, Hendricks looks to flick it but gets a leading edge which falls short of the cover fielder.
Time for spin. Dhananjaya de Silva is into the attack.
On middle and leg, Markram hits it straight to the fielder at mid on.
Good change of pace on this one. It is bowled at 101 kph. Full outside off, Markram looks to push it to the off side but gets beaten.
Follows the boundary with a dot. Good length ball on off, Markram punches it to cover.
FOUR! Excellent shot. Full length delivery on off, Markram maintains his balance and plays a beautiful cover drive for a boundary.
WIDE! Udana misses his line completely and bowls this full down the leg side. Markram looks to flick it but misses. Wide signalled.
Good length delivery outside off, Hendricks runs it down to third man and rotates the strike.
Udana bowls the first one on a length around off. Hendricks just pushes it to the fielder at point.
Isuru Udana to bowl from the other end.
Reeza is off the mark after 4 dot balls. It is full on middle and leg, Hendricks flicks it away to deep square leg for a single. He will keep the strike.
Wide! Back of a length delivery way wide outside off, Hendricks looks to pull it away but cannot do so. Wide signalled.
On the pads this time. It is full too. Hendricks flicks it to the man at short fine leg and looks for a single. Markram says no.
Slower one in the very first over from Malinga. It is on a length on off, Hendricks calmly waits for it and blocks it.
Back of a length delivery on off, Reeza blocks it.
Good looking stroke this by Hendricks. Length ball on off, Reeza strokes it wide of cover. Akila runs to his right and saves run by diving to his right. Good fielding.
Malinga starts with a length ball on off. Hint of away swing on this first ball. Markram is off the mark straightaway with a gentle push towards point.
We are all set to begin, out walk the South African opening pair of Aiden Markram and Reeza Hendricks. Sri Lankan skipper, Lasith Malinga to start the proceedings with the new ball.

Toss - Sri Lanka win the toss and opt to bowl first in the final game of the tour. Two changes for the hosts. Junior Dala and Andile Phehlukwayo come in place of Rassie van der Dussen and Dale Steyn. There is a change for the visitors too. Kusal Mendis makes way for Suranga Lakmal.

Hello and a warm welcome to the third T20I between South Africa and Sri Lanka at Johannesburg. The hosts have already sealed the series and will be looking for a whitewash. On the other hand, Sri Lanka will be playing for pride and would want their batsmen to step up. Thisara Perera has not played the best innings till now and would look to improve his record. What is in store for us? Stay tuned for the toss.
